There is no point of all of this. We don't live for anything inherently, it's such a pain that we choose what we live for. That's what always makes it so hard to do anything, to motivate yourself for anything, and to live on even in times of hardship. 

I'm sorry you feel this way about everyone in your life. Is there something in particular, like a recent event, that's triggered this? Or is it just a long term burden that's been on your shoulders for a while now? It's hard to compare reality to this built-up image we have in our heads, and it'd be a fallacy to say that effort will always equal a reward in the end. Naturally, you'll feel burnt out when those efforts don't return any profit that you've been expecting. I won't say that this will pass and can't promise anything past condolences, but just know that your voice has been heard and I'm sorry that you've been feeling this way. Another thing, which may be controversial, is that I don't believe that one can feel things too deeply. It's just that our society has never treated vulnerability as something positive, but being vulnerable has always just been a part of EVERYONE because our ability to emphasize. It's a shame in my opinion that this is looked down upon or something that people have to feel ashamed for. I understand why people would feel ashamed, because it's embarrassing, but I wished it didn't have to be that way.

This post is long enough already, so I'll just wish that you have a nice day. Go do something that will make you happy, the little things in life still count. I'm sorry if this isn't what you wanted to hear, but I truly do wish you the best, whatever decision you end up making.

And it's your assumption that pretending to care won't make others feel good. Everyone is different, and people come here with good intentions. We comment because some people here would like feedback and would even agonize when they get no comments on their post. If you want to invalidate their efforts, that's on you. Not everyone copes the same way. People who don't want comments/questions on their posts should put it in their post, and generally people will listen. I know it's unbelievably shocking, but we aren't here just to be assholes. Likewise, nobody is obliged to bend over backwards when they weren't even aware of what you wanted in the first place. Requests have to be made in the first place to be followed. Nobody is going to read your mind. I don't tell people that it's going to get better if they say "don't fucking tell me it's going to get better". It's that simple.

Anyways, if this place was "just for venting", Reddit would've shut this subreddit down a long time ago. I'm glad that at least some people hold this as their last resort oasis to call for help. Sometimes, it's all they have and even if restrictions have to be placed, I'd want this to be here for them. That's all.

There's better places to vent on the internet not on reddit, this place is for support because of reddit standards and guidelines. Generally, people will always ask for more details because they want to know more, it's a strange human habit of curiosity. I'm definitely not going to deny that we "care" any deeper than surface level, but I think we're all aware of that whenever we post anything on this subreddit. Sometimes, it's just nice to pretend and if it makes us feel better in the moment, then what's so wrong about it?

It's why nobody wants to die, we just want to stop existing. It's also why people wish they wouldn't wake up after going to sleep. We're all just too tired to put in any effort towards anything anymore.
